description: Phase 2 of local-safe-by-default: prod-run injects a REAL prod env blob from ~/.mumate-prod/ into ONE process (never written to disk — env lives only in the spawned child) so connecting to prod has the lifetime of a command, not the machine's rest-state. Guards: (1) NO disk write (censused file-list before/after — vault sha + $TMPDIR unchanged, 0 new files, git clean x3); (2) loud banner naming app + prod DB *family only* (e.g. supabase.com), never a raw env value; (3) HARD-TYPED confirmation at a REAL TTY — the app name, never y/Enter, AND process.stdin.isTTY is required so a pipe/here-string/CI CANNOT auto-confirm (ตู๋ lens #3, the hole บอง caught in review: `printf 'be\nSEND-REAL\n' | prod-run --with-providers be` must not auto-arm live SMS/payment). Neg-controls: plain pipe → refuse exit 6; pipe+--with-providers → refuse exit 6; both: command never runs; (4) never prints an env value even on error; (5) dangerous-button providers BLOCKED by default (LINE_HOST/SMS_8X8_HOST→.invalid DNS-dead, SENDGRID/OMISE keys→sentinel) and only LIVE via --with-providers + a SECOND 'SEND-REAL' confirmation (connect-real ≠ fire-real); refuses any `build` command (NEXT_PUBLIC_* bake at build time but prod-run injects at runtime → would ship wrong browser values and fail SILENTLY). Project topology (ฟีม-confirmed 2026-07-27, declared in the vault file headers since 2026-06-19): soxsccdlsycaevusndro = PROD (real; in be.env.prod.local + be.env.local); jgxsjhbdhttfoiyvptvy = DEV (de-prod'd 2026-06-19, now paused → Supavisor 'tenant/user not found', confirmed by BOTH psql and the app's postgres.js); Neon = backup DB. Mapping (VERIFIED with ฟีม): be→be.env.prod.local (PROD); bazi→bazi.env.local (Neon backup); fe→REFUSED outright (no prod key on disk — fe.env.local is DEV; refuse rather than connect to dev believing it's prod). PRE-FLIGHT (fix #1): before spawning, a read-only `select 1` verifies the blob reaches a LIVE prod DB; on failure REFUSE with a human why/means/do message (worded per ฟีม: 'points at DEV or a paused tenant, NOT prod — dev isn't broken, it's a different place', not 'stale/gone') instead of letting the app fail silently deep inside (ตู๋ lens #5) — correct no matter which blob is right. Review round (บอง+ตู๋ converged): the pre-flight uses the repo's OWN `postgres` client (the same one the app runs via lib/db, ssl:'require'+prepare:false) NOT psql — a psql check could go green while the app breaks on SSL/pooler/prepared-statements = false-green. The 'proceeding UNVERIFIED when psql absent' branch is DELETED (fix-it-away): no psql dependency at all; if `postgres` is unresolvable → REFUSE (no-client), never proceed. A 15s overall timeout races connect AND query (connect_timeout alone can't catch a post-connect query hang → would hang silently) → timeout category → REFUSE. Mechanism proven on safe local targets (localhost:5433→ok, dead port→connect-failed, race→timeout) + real Supavisor (jgxsj→tenant-not-found, soxsc→ok, via postgres.js, ฟีม-authorized + now capped). Teeth (real machine, read-only only, one ฟีม-authorized soxsc hit now capped): pre-flight against the DEV ref → 'tenant-not-found' → REFUSE (exit 5), command never ran; pre-flight verdict 'ok' for the live soxsc ref (psql select 1 status 0 = same verdict as postgres.js); fe→refuse exit 4; build→refuse exit 3; isTTY neg-controls both refuse; providers default-blocked (ENOTFOUND) vs --with-providers live; zero files written. gate_layer=infra/tooling + runtime-preflight.
